name: Molten Core: Ragnaros casts both Super Nova groups from 10s and 15s, every 12s
contract: Archive WoWCombatLog evidence (12 Ragnaros pulls): Super Nova group A (2108627-30) first lands 10.0s after the pull and group B (2108662-65) 15.0s after it,
each repeating every 12.0s (12.0-12.2s between salvos) while Ragnaros is emerged. The Normal ids 2108627 and 2108662 are the ones this fixture
resolves. The scenario asserts both groups are silent before their first cast, then land, then repeat.
Ragnaros carries UNIT_FLAG_IMMUNE_TO_PC until his real summon intro clears it, so a raw aggressive fixture cannot be attacked at all; this case reaches
him through the real Majordomo summon sequence (spell_summon_ragnaros/EVENT_RAGNAROS_SUMMON_1..6, EVENT_INTRO_SAY, EVENT_INTRO_MAKE_ATTACKABLE), the
same path molten-core-ragnaros-survives-majordomo.json drives, instead of spawning him directly. EVENT_INTRO_MAKE_ATTACKABLE calls DoZoneInCombat(),
which pulls the nearby hero into combat on its own, so the pull timestamp is that event, not an explicit attack.

steps.label: Configure the survival health before Ragnaros can attack
CONTROL: the hero is in Molten Core
CONTROL: Ragnaros does not exist yet
Spawn the friendly Majordomo and start the Ragnaros summon sequence
Let the summon sequence run up to Majordomo casting Elemental Fire and Ragnaros's DoAction(ACTION_FINISH_RAGNAROS_INTRO)
Ragnaros exists right after his intro is triggered to finish
Let EVENT_INTRO_SAY (5s) fire; EVENT_INTRO_MAKE_ATTACKABLE (2.5s more) has not fired yet
Let EVENT_INTRO_MAKE_ATTACKABLE fire: this is the pull, via its own DoZoneInCombat()
The pull: Ragnaros's DoZoneInCombat() put the hero in combat without an explicit attack
6s past the pull: still short of Super Nova's 10s/15s first casts
Super Nova group A has not landed before its 10s first cast
Super Nova group B has not landed before its 15s first cast
Super Nova group A lands about 10s after the pull
Super Nova group B lands about 15s after the pull
Super Nova group A repeats 12s after its first cast
Super Nova group B repeats 12s after its first cast
